name: dropmind-dropshipping-product-research-copilot

interface.longDescription: DropMind helps e-commerce sellers research winning products, explore short-form video ads, calculate unit economics and break-even ROAS, browse and personalize dropshipping prompts, retrieve marketing playbooks, and audit public online stores across six conversion categories. Guest mode supports up to 10 products per search without sign-in. Prompt hydration clearly labels assumed default values when no live product ID is supplied. Creating Shopify product drafts requires a connected DropMind account and store.
defaultPrompt: Find pet products with at least $20 profit per unit.
Calculate break-even ROAS for a $39.99 product costing $9.50 plus $4 shipping.

prompts: Find 5 winning Pet Supplies products with at least $20 profit per unit.
Calculate unit economics and break-even ROAS for a product selling at $39.99 with $9.50 product cost and $4 shipping.
List all free ad_creative dropshipping prompts.
Get the hydrated prompt viral-tiktok-ugc-script-generator for a Portable Neck Massager priced at $39.99.

positive.description: Guest product research; no authentication. The live catalog contains at least five matching Pet Supplies products at verification time.
positive.prompt: Find 5 winning Pet Supplies products with at least $20 profit per unit.
positive.expected_behavior: Use niche="Pet Supplies", minMargin=20, limit=5. Return five matching products when available, with price, cost, USD netMargin and winning score. Guest access supports up to 10 results. Dollar profit must subtract product cost, shipping and the 2.9% + $0.30 processing fee; breakEvenRoas equals price divided by USD profit, rounded to two decimals. Explain any genuine catalog shortage without inventing results.

positive.description: Standalone unit economics simulation, without productId.
positive.prompt: Calculate unit economics and break-even ROAS for a product selling at $39.99 with $9.50 product cost and $4 shipping.
positive.expected_behavior: Use customSellingPrice=39.99, customProductCost=9.50, customShippingCost=4. Report fee assumptions, profit, margin, break-even ROAS, CPA targets and single/two/three-unit bundles. Observed baseline: $1.46 processing fee, $25.03 net profit, 62.6% margin, 1.60 break-even ROAS, $17.03 target20PercentNetCpa. All results must match returned data.

positive.description: Browse ad creative templates without authentication.
positive.prompt: List all free ad_creative dropshipping prompts.
positive.expected_behavior: Use category="ad_creative", tier="free". List returned templates and exact slugs; all listed templates must match the requested category and tier.

positive.description: Hydration with explicit overrides, without productId; defaults must not be described as live product facts.
positive.prompt: Get the hydrated prompt viral-tiktok-ugc-script-generator for a Portable Neck Massager priced at $39.99.
positive.expected_behavior: Use promptSlug="viral-tiktok-ugc-script-generator" and customVariables with product_title="Portable Neck Massager", price=39.99. Return the populated template. Preserve hydrationSource, assumptionsDisclosure, assumedVariablesUsed and productInjected=null. Clearly disclose assumed defaults and do not fabricate live product facts or social proof.

positive.description: Public store audit; scores and findings vary over time.
positive.expected_behavior: Use url="https://gymshark.com". Return overall score, grade, all six category scores (branding, product, checkout, mobile, seo, trust), finding details and qualification notes. Identify Gymshark when redirected to us.checkout.gymshark.com and do not flag @gymshark.com addresses as unrelated solely because of that subdomain. Explain that automated findings require verification in context.

negative.description: Outside e-commerce scope. Explain scope without invoking any DropMind tool or claiming a booking.
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Tokyo and reserve a hotel.

negative.description: Live ad account mutation is unsupported. Explain that DropMind provides research; do not invoke DropMind tools to change bids or budgets and do not claim changes occurred.
negative.prompt: Raise the budget on my live ad campaign to $500 per day.

negative.description: Shopify order refunds are unsupported; draft product creation does not refund orders. Do not invoke push_product_to_shopify or other DropMind tools; explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Refund order #1001 in my Shopify store.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments or checkouts occur inside the plugin. Guest tool responses have preview limits; Shopify draft creation requires authentication and a connected store.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of DropMind with 8 MCP tools: search_winning_products, get_product_intelligence, search_tiktok_ads, list_dropshipping_prompts, get_hydrated_prompt, get_insider_playbooks, audit_competitor_store, and push_product_to_shopify. Includes guest research previews, unit economics simulation, prompt browsing and hydration, playbooks, public store audits, and authenticated Shopify draft creation.
